After experiencing repeated episodes of severe vomiting, I had felt completely fobbed off by A&E and other doctors and was starting to lose hope of being taken seriously. Dr Wood was the first person who truly listened to me. He took the time to understand my symptoms, acknowledged my concerns, and made me feel heard and believed.
